demoBanner: Demo version: all people and data shown are fictional.

unreachable.title: The server can’t be reached
unreachable.text: The app could not reach IUA Connect at {address}. In the demo, the phone must be on the same Wi-Fi as the computer that runs it.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use the same email and password as on the IUA Connect site.
signIn.codeIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or a recovery code.
signIn.forgot: Forgot your password? Reset it on the site.
signIn.join: Not a member yet? Join on the site.
signIn.passkeyNote: Passkeys don’t work in the app yet. Use your password, and your authenticator code if you have one.

home.title: IUA Connect
home.staffNote: You have a staff role. The admin area is on the website; the app is for members’ everyday use.
home.none: You have no membership yet. Joining is done on the website.
home.unread: {count, plural, =0 {No unread notifications} one {# unread notification} other {# unread notifications}}

language.title: Language
language.restart: The direction of the text changes with the language. Close the app and open it again to finish the change.

account.signOutEverywhereHint: Ends every session of your account: this phone, other phones and browsers.

lock.title: Unlock IUA Connect
lock.failed: The phone did not recognise you. Try again, or sign out.
lock.setting: Ask for my fingerprint or face when the app opens
lock.settingHint: Uses the lock your phone already has. Nothing about your fingerprint or face leaves the phone.
lock.notAvailable: This phone has no fingerprint or face unlock set up, so the app opens without asking.

check.title: Connection check
check.intro: For the first test on your phone: whether live updates (used by chat) arrive.
check.running: Listening, for up to thirty seconds…
check.ok: Live updates arrive on this phone.
check.failed: Live updates did not arrive. Chat will ask the server every few seconds instead.

card.offline: No connection. This is your card as it was on {date}. The code can’t be shown without a connection, because it changes every few minutes.
card.brightness: Turn the screen’s brightness up if the code doesn’t scan.

events.checkInNote: At the venue, scan the code shown there with your phone’s camera. It opens the website, which records your attendance.
events.calendarOnSite: The calendar file is on the website.

notices.onSite: This one opens on the website.

chat.noCamera: The app may not use the camera. You can allow it in the phone’s settings.
